certification.name: Google Cloud Google Security Operations Professional Certificate
certification.description: Three Google Cloud courses on the Google Security Operations (Chronicle) platform covering investigation, search, data ingestion, detections and modern security operations principles. Course-based certificate with no proctored exam.
certification.currency_note: Program bundle price $121.50 shown on the edX page (list $135 for the courses bought separately); one-off payment, not a subscription.
